'''Nkllon''' was a small, mineral rich, harsh [[Planet/Legends|world]] in the [[Athega system]]. Its surface was covered in plains of searing rock, impact craters, and [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] features.
[[File:Nkllon_miners.png|thumb|left|200px|Nkllon miners]]
The crust of the planet was rich in the minerals [[hfredium]], [[Kammris/Legends|kammris]], and [[Dolovite/Legends|dolovite]]; metals vital in construction of [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. [[Mining/Legends|Mining]] operations were previously impossible in the planet however, as Nkllon was bathed in lethal [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]] from its small [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] around the [[Star system/Legends|system's]] [[Star/Legends|star]] during the day. However, before [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] took a [[Gambling/Legends|gamble]] at an operation to mine Nkllon. Using a giant mobile mining complex called [[Nomad City]], the operation could be carried out permanently during the night time, with ships visiting the system being protected by giant, super-cooled radiation umbrella vessels called [[shieldship]]s.

[[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] raided Nomad City twice. The [[Raid on Nomad City|first raid]] was to steal its complement of [[Plasma-Jet Mole Miner|mole miners]] to use during his [[Battle of Sluis Van|assault]] on [[Sluis Van/Legends|Sluis Van]]. He succeeded in capturing just over half of them. In the [[Destruction of Nomad City|second raid]], he stole millions of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and stockpiles of resources, but damaged Nomad City beyond repair. The workers were evacuated, but Nomad City was utterly destroyed by the intense radiation of Nkllon's daytime.
{{Planet-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Nkllon was named by author [[Timothy Zahn]] after a fan, Klon Newell.<ref name="HTTE20">''[[Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition]]''</ref>
